articles.title: Watch Steve Jobs in the full 'Antennagate' video before it gets erased again
articles.description: Unless you were in the room when Steve Jobs gave his 2010 "you're holding it wrong" speech, you've only seen half of it. Now the full version is online and it's a great watch. To fix signal strength dropping if you held the iPhone 4 a certain way, Apple offered customers a free bumper case - image credit: Apple. This is a famous moment in Apple history and even if you don't remember when the iPhone 4 had signal problems , this is still a video to watch that you've never been able to see before. It's from the emergency event that Apple called to try getting ahead of this antennagate problem. It was huge at the time and for many years Apple kept a video of it online. But that video was about 34 minutes long and the actual event went on for a further 47 minutes. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: IIT Delhi develops India's first indigenous micro Graphics Processing Unit
articles.description: Researchers at Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi have designed country's first working, demonstrable indigenous micro Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), in a significant development that can reduce import dependence to a large extent, officials said on Thursday. According to officials, GPUs are widely used in modern hardware, including in AI and Machine Learning engines. Currently, all GPUs are imported. This is the first working, demonstrable indigenously designed micro-GPU from India, they said. The micro-GPU architecture developed by IIT Delhi researchers will enable indigenous graphics and display-processing systems for embedded applications. The researchers at the institute's Electrical Engineering department have demonstrated programmable graphics rendering using a custom floating point GPU engine implemented entirely in Register Transfer Language (RTL) and mapped to a Spartan-7 Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platform. articles.title: New Apple Watch models could restart randomly, & watchOS 27.0.1 fixes that bug
articles.description: Apple's watchOS 27.0.1 update has arrived with a fix that prevents Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 models from randomly restarting. New Apple Watch models could encounter restarts during use On Wednesday, just over a week after watchOS 27.0 reached the general public, Apple deployed the watchOS 27.0.1 update. The software addresses a bug that caused the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 to restart unexpectedly. Those who encountered the now-resolved issue said their Apple Watch rebooted while editing watch faces, making calls, using Siri AI, opening Apple Maps or the App Store , and recording workouts.
